biomarkers.name: Mitochondrial DNA mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Characteristic molecular feature supporting distinction from non-oncocytic follicular thyroid carcinoma

biomarkers.name: Thyroglobulin
biomarkers.clinical_use: Monitoring after thyroidectomy/ablation; interpretation may be affected in poorly differentiated/dedifferentiated disease

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Oncocytic (large eosinophilic granular cytoplasm from mitochondrial accumulation) cells in follicular, trabecular, or solid pattern
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Categorised by extent of capsular and/or vascular invasion; often more aggressive than non-oncocytic follicular thyroid carcinoma

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Thyroid follicular epithelial cells with oncocytic (mitochondrial) transformation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Oncocytic (H rthle cell) phenotype with mitochondrial accumulation; often reduced iodine avidity
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: mtDNA mutations disrupt oxidative phosphorylation, driving compensatory mitochondrial biogenesis and the oncocytic phenotype; loss of iodine avidity is common
